outcome: Document review: read a drafted client document, see what changed and what was checked, approve it or return it with a note (contract mock only)
acceptance_criteria: Opening `/projects/P-0102/documents/<SOW id>?v=2` as the acting persona shows crumb "LAGOON HEALTH / DOCUMENTS / SOW-0198", heading "Statement of work · v2", status tag, TEST TEMPLATE tag, five numbered sections, section 4 tinted with the Tola note labelled as agent text, a Checks panel with the three backend checks, Audience rows and the buttons "Approve v2" and "Return with note" — verify: e2e `document-review.spec.ts` at 1440 and 390 widths; page text.

The Documents tab of P-0102 lists its documents (title, version, status, TEST TEMPLATE tag) and each row with a `work_id` opens the review page; a row without one is text — verify: e2e on `/projects/P-0102/documents`.

Approve sends claim then decision once with the read `expected_revision` and no note; the page then shows the green "You approved v2 · <name> · <time>. Not sent to the client." taken from the re-read, and no controls — verify: e2e with request log; the text "sent to the client" never appears as a done state.

Return with an empty note shows a field error, announced, and sends nothing; with a note it sends `verdict: "return"` and the note, then shows the returned state with the quote — verify: e2e plus unit test of the note rule.

The returned state (`psl_mock_document=returned`) shows "RETURNED TO PM", "Returned by Kemi Adebayo (PMO Lead) · <time>", the quoted note, "Approval on v2 is not carried over", Tola's panel and the sections; with `returned-hidden` no quote appears and the page says the note isn't shown — verify: e2e both variants.

"Ask Tola to draft v3" and "Edit as v3" are disabled with "Not available yet", have no handler, and no request to any drafting or document-save URL is made when they are pressed — verify: e2e request log; grep for no `POST /documents` in `frontend/src`.

A person without `you_can_act` sees no Approve, Return or note field, and the `cannotActCopy` sentence (`prepared_by_you` variant included); a persona claiming "PMO Lead" in `/me` without `you_can_act` gets no controls — verify: e2e `cannot-act` and persona variants.
With no `review.task_id` the page is read-only and sends no claim or decision — verify: e2e `no-review` with request log.

The amounts check reads Unknown (tag and text) when the backend sends `unknown`, never "Matches"; the page contains no check status the backend did not send — verify: e2e `amount-unknown`; unit test of the check mapping (all four statuses plus absent).

Section text and notes render as plain text: a fixture containing `<script>` and `<b>` tags shows the characters, not markup; `body_url` appears only as a link — verify: unit/e2e test with a hostile fixture.

Wrong user or tenant: 401 shows the sign-in state; 403 and 404 show the same "not open to you" state with no title leak; a document of a case the persona cannot see never renders section text — verify: e2e with `psl_mock_scenario` 401/403/404 and persona `none`.

A 409 on decision shows the generic stale message, re-reads, enables nothing automatically and sends no second decision; a 422 shows the note error; a network failure or 5xx after the write shows no "approved", re-reads the item first, and the retry is a deliberate press — verify: e2e with scenario cookies.
A provider/read failure shows the error card with "Try again" that re-reads; loading shows the shared loading state with no controls — verify: e2e.
The same document with `?v=1` and `?v=2` shows each version's own state; a missing or non-numeric `v` is not found — verify: e2e.
A document with no `sections` shows the download link and "The text isn't available here."; with `sections: []` it shows the empty sentence — verify: e2e `no-sections`.

The phone (390px) shows the back link "← <project>", the single amounts tag, the "<agent> flagged section 4" line, and Approve/Return as 44px targets in the phone action bar; Return opens the drawer with the labelled note field — verify: e2e at 390 width; computed target size ≥44px.

Keyboard and screen reader: headings in order, labelled note field, errors announced (`role="alert"` or the existing summary), visible focus, reduced-motion respected, no axe violations at 390 and 1440 on default, returned and cannot-act — verify: axe in the e2e spec.

Design fidelity: UI review passes the design-fidelity check of all 4 boards, every element present after approved exceptions, score ≥ 90 with the listed visual waivers per D-83/D-64, one run per round — verify: the fidelity tool output; exceptions in `delivery/features/F-29/fidelity-exceptions.json`.

Existing tests stay green: F-04 decide, F-25 project tabs, F-23 minutes (the minutes `D-2304` E-DOCUMENT behaviour unchanged) — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`, plus `decide.spec.ts`, `project-tabs.spec.ts`, `minutes.spec.ts`.

risk.rationale: Medium. Several behaviours (a document read, a decision write, a returned state) cross the layers on a contract that has seven proposed additive gaps, and one new route links the Documents tab to the decide writes. It is not high because there is no new authority, money, identity or migration. Decisions reuse the built E-TASK-DECIDE with its server-side checks, and the work is frontend and mock only (frontend/src/features, frontend/mock). SURFACES are ui, api and contract-change. PRODUCT-ACCEPTANCE is required: the document layout, the checks wording and the returned-state copy are new to the client. A product decision on the two draft-next-version buttons is needed from the design engineer as an exception, not as a block.

completion.reason: Project, readiness, implementation and review evidence has not been supplied.
